scope: Actual canonical-domain-redirect module executed in Node.js with stateful mocked REST responses; no live database, browser cache, Cloudflare cache or provider verification
defaultBehavior: Unchanged 308 free-host redirect and legacy cache headers
enabledBehavior: Free-host redirect becomes 307 with Cache-Control no-store, max-age=0; www-to-apex behavior unchanged

negativeControl.purpose: Shows tests detect missing opt-in policy, not three production regressions

statefulCase: After fixture domain moves from source to target, source free hostname stops producing a fresh custom redirect and target free hostname redirects under enabled policy
limits: Does not invalidate previously issued cached redirects
No global cache or multi-PoP purge guarantee
No live provider/DNS/HTTPS or full application verification
Rollout of flag and handling existing caches require separate approval/verification before real transfers
No merge, deployment or production activation
